arguments.heading: What happened at the argument

Omega's lawyer argued copyright law protects domestic distribution rights.
The government argued lawfully made means made under Title 17.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Costco wants to import Omega watches. Omega wants to block those imports. The Court must decide if copyright law allows this block.
